name: decision-evidence
tagline: Know Why Every AI Decision Was Made
description: Structured decision evidence for every AI agent response. Captures inputs, reasoning, tools used, and confidence levels in a compact, auditable format. Complements the AOCL Compliance Suite by generating the evidence that compliance exports rely on.
shortDescription: Structured decision evidence capture for AI agent responses.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Structured evidence for every AI decision, not just logs
Four evidence levels: minimal, standard, full, or off
Automatic VOLT recording for tamper-evident audit trails
Search and filter decisions by confidence, tools used, or time range
Complements Compliance Suite for auditor-ready exports

evidenceCapture.name: Evidence Capture
evidenceCapture.description: Every AI response includes structured decision evidence: what inputs were considered, which tools were used, what was decided, and why.

evidenceTimeline.name: Evidence Timeline
evidenceTimeline.description: Chronological view of all decision evidence across conversations. Filter by agent, confidence level, or time range.

evidenceSearch.name: Evidence Search
evidenceSearch.description: Full-text search across decision evidence. Find every decision that referenced a specific tool, input, or keyword.

evidenceExport.name: Evidence Export
evidenceExport.description: Export decision evidence as JSON or CSV for external analysis, compliance reporting, or integration with third-party audit tools.

tokenAnalytics.name: Token Analytics
tokenAnalytics.description: Track the token overhead of decision evidence per level. Optimise the evidence-to-cost ratio for your workload.

evidenceLevel.label: Default Evidence Level
evidenceLevel.description: Level of decision evidence included in AI responses

options.label: Standard — Full evidence except context refs

enforceForAllAgents.label: Enforce for All Agents
enforceForAllAgents.description: When enabled, all agents must include decision evidence at the configured level. When disabled, evidence is optional per conversation.

autoVoltRecord.label: Auto-Record to VOLT
autoVoltRecord.description: Automatically record decision evidence in VOLT tamper-evident chains. Requires VOLT to be configured.

testimonials.quote: We went from 'the AI said so' to 'here is exactly why, with evidence.' Our compliance team finally trusts the agents.
testimonials.author: VP Engineering, Financial Services

testimonials.quote: Decision Evidence plus the Compliance Suite is the combination that got us through our SOC2 Type II audit.
testimonials.author: Head of Platform, Healthcare SaaS

changes: Four evidence levels (none, minimal, standard, full)
Evidence capture in AI responses via system prompt injection
Org-scoped configuration with admin enforcement toggle
